items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Art Hodes, you know, is far as strong. Because Art didn't get any much more? Yeah, Art gets a lot. See, Art goes on these tours and things, he and France.

ctx.x: It's pretty good. Yeah, we played nothing but the 50s. Yeah, but the French, that's the only band, isn't it? Well, no, not the only band. That's about the only colored band. But Art Hodes, you know, is far as strong. Because Art didn't get any much more? Yeah, Art gets a lot. See, Art goes on these tours and things, he and France. See, France just leaves his band and goes on the 50s.
But Art doesn't get any much more?
